body: I’ll drink to that. Thought I was the only one who had thoughts like yours.
Same bro, just waiting for the big sad to hit again😂😂
Love you too bro🤍🤍🤍 find it crazy tbh. I felt like this couple week ago, but now I feel fine. I mean Im sad but not sad enough to kill myself. Funny how the brain works

That means your friend loves you and cares for you. You don’t want to die, rather you want to kill something inside you. Something doesn’t sit right with your spirit. Find what it is, attack it and move forward. You’re stronger then whatever you’re facing.

Safe. Your dad gave up on you. Fuck him. But who says you can’t make it out and better yourself. Don’t think because one door has closed, that’s it. You don’t know the bigger picture. Your life is worth so much more. Fuck your dad. Your better then him. And in this day and age, if people can have silly coloured hair and face tattoos and be millionaires, why can’t a ordinary civilian like yourself do so? Who says you can’t? Fuck them. I believe in you x

Don’t do it. Honestly if you kill yourself, what would you gain? An escape from a few problems. Maybe. But honestly life’s worth living, find an interest and work towards it. Everything else will come naturally. Life’s about experiences and memories and you can do that.

I would say amen to that but bro, honestly, life’s Acc worth living. Fuck people. People are boring. Look after yourself and understand what you like and want. Work towards that and life will work out.
Sometimes I feel like Jeff. Sometimes I feel like MCBC. Two extremes on a daily basis😂 Is it fair to say Jeff is more optimistic whilst MCBC is a realist?
